Order No. 03 Dated- 19.05.2023  Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Chakradharpur P.S. Case No. 16 of 2023 instituted under Sections 376/313 of the Indian Penal Code, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
As per F.I.R. allegation against the petitioner is that he had established physical relationship with the informant on false assurance/promise of marriage in spite of her stout protest.

It is further alleged that the petitioner falsely posed himself to be unmarried person and indulged in sexual intercourse, due to which she became pregnant and petitioner caused her abortion by administering some medicines and declined to performe marriage.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is further submitted that petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case and will not indulge in tampering with prosecution evidence and will abide by all terms and conditions imposed by this Court in the matter of granting anticipatory bail.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, serious and heinous nature of the offence alleged to be committed by the petitioner coupled with materials available on record showing dishonest intention of petitioner to satisfy his sexual lust alone, I am not inclined to extend privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner is Nirmal Behra vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130184960/
1 rejected.
